name: bulkpublish
title: BulkPublish
description: Write, schedule and publish social media posts to all your BulkPublish channels, and keep an eye on your queue, without leaving Raycast.
author: azeemkafridi

commands.name: create-post
commands.title: Create Post
commands.subtitle: BulkPublish
commands.description: Write a post and publish it now, add it to your queue, schedule it or save it as a draft.

commands.name: search-posts
commands.title: Search Posts
commands.subtitle: BulkPublish
commands.description: Browse and search your recent posts, see where each one was published, and retry or publish them.

commands.name: view-queue
commands.title: View Queue
commands.subtitle: BulkPublish
commands.description: See what is scheduled to go out next, day by day, and your next free queue slot.

commands.name: list-channels
commands.title: List Channels
commands.subtitle: BulkPublish
commands.description: See your connected social accounts and which ones need attention.

preferences.name: apiKey
preferences.title: API Key
preferences.description: Your BulkPublish API key. Create one at app.bulkpublish.com/developer. It starts with bp_.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
